description: Get Price by ID for a Product. The "Get Price by ID for a Product" API allows retrieving information for a specific price associated with a particular product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single price based on the provided price ID and product ID.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_getPriceByIdForProduct
